explication: WeakAuras is a World of Warcraft addon for configuring and displaying customizable visual alerts. The documented user flow starts by opening the options window with /wa or /weakauras (or the minimap icon), configuring displays, and using game-related triggers to show relevant information. The README also describes animations, grouping, side effects, conditional loading, and user-defined customization. No source excerpts were provided, so the relationships shown are limited to those stated in the README; paths identify relevant implementation areas from the tree.
